headline: Hackers steal data on millions in Pentagon personnel breach
summary: Hackers breached Pentagon human resources systems in a months-long intrusion beginning around October 2025, stealing personal records on millions of current and former military and civilian personnel. Outlets differ slightly on the exact number affected, describing it as just under or just over three million.

claims.statement: Hackers breached Pentagon systems and stole personal data on roughly three million military and civilian personnel.

sources.quote: breach exposes sensitive data on nearly three million military and civilian personnel
Hackers stole millions of US military personnel records during months-long data breach
Hackers stole Pentagon personnel records of over 3 million people
